rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Career answers should include skills, planning and risk — not just ambition.
Entrepreneurship = spotting a problem and solving it profitably; state this formula.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: CV/cover-letter questions follow fixed formats — memorise the CV sections (personal details, objective, education, experience, skills, references) and the letter's block layout; format errors cost the most marks.  ·  Trick 2: Job-application questions reward SPECIFICITY — name the post, the source of the vacancy, and match two of your skills to the job requirements.
